info.title: Taxley free UK Corporation Tax tools
info.description: Free calculators for UK limited companies: the same results as the tool pages on taxley.co.uk. No key needed; please link to the share_url when you use a result. General guidance from Taxley's free calculator, based on the rules published on GOV.UK. It is not tax advice; check your own figures before you file or pay.

/api/v1/tools/corporation-tax.description: Estimates the Corporation Tax a UK limited company pays on its taxable profits for one accounting period of up to 12 months. Applies the small profits rate, the main rate and marginal relief, with associated companies, short periods and periods that straddle 1 April.

get.description: Estimates the Corporation Tax a UK limited company pays on its taxable profits for one accounting period of up to 12 months. Applies the small profits rate, the main rate and marginal relief, with associated companies, short periods and periods that straddle 1 April.

parameters.name: period_start
parameters.description: First day of the accounting period, YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2025-04-01).

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Last day of the accounting period, YYYY-MM-DD. No more than 12 months after the start.

parameters.name: taxable_profits
parameters.description: Taxable total profits for the period in pounds, after tax adjustments and reliefs (CT600 box 315).

parameters.name: associated_companies
parameters.description: How many other companies are associated with this one (under common control) in the period. Leave at 0 for a standalone company.

parameters.name: exempt_distributions
parameters.description: Exempt dividends received from companies outside the company's 51% group (and not from a trading company owned by a consortium it belongs to) (CTA 2010 s.18L), in pounds, used only to decide the rate. They are not taxed.

parameters.name: close_investment_holding
parameters.description: True if the company is a close investment-holding company in the period (CTA 2010 s.18N): a close company is one unless, throughout the period, it exists wholly or mainly to trade commercially, to let land to people not connected with it, or to hold, lend to, administer or serve companies under its (or its parent's) control that do (or that hold such companies). It pays the main rate on all its profits, with no small profits rate or marginal relief. Leave false for most companies.

/api/v1/tools/late-penalty.summary: Corporation Tax late filing penalty and interest calculator
/api/v1/tools/late-penalty.description: Works out HMRC's penalties for filing a UK company's Company Tax Return (CT600) late — the flat £200/£400 penalties for filing deadlines from 1 April 2026 (£100/£200 before then), and the 10% or 20% tax-geared penalty — plus late payment interest on the Corporation Tax at HMRC's published rates.

get.summary: Corporation Tax late filing penalty and interest calculator (query string)
get.description: Works out HMRC's penalties for filing a UK company's Company Tax Return (CT600) late — the flat £200/£400 penalties for filing deadlines from 1 April 2026 (£100/£200 before then), and the 10% or 20% tax-geared penalty — plus late payment interest on the Corporation Tax at HMRC's published rates.

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Last day of the Corporation Tax accounting period the CT600 covers (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after 2015-04-01.

parameters.name: period_of_account_end
parameters.description: Only if the company's accounts cover more than 12 months (up to 18): the last day of that period of account, no more than 6 months after period_end. Every CT600 for those accounts is then due 12 months after this date. Leave out otherwise.

parameters.name: filed_on
parameters.description: The date the CT600 was, or will be, filed with HMRC.

parameters.name: tax_due
parameters.description: Corporation Tax payable for the accounting period, in pounds. 0 or leave out if there is none (the flat penalties still apply).

parameters.name: paid_on
parameters.description: The date the Corporation Tax was, or will be, paid in full. Leave out if it has not been paid: the tax then counts as unpaid for the 10%/20% penalty, and interest is worked out up to filed_on (it keeps running after that).

parameters.name: late_previous_two
parameters.description: True if the company was liable to a late filing penalty for each of its two previous accounting periods (consecutive, and within Corporation Tax throughout). A third late return in a row costs £1,000 or £2,000 instead of £200 or £400.

422.description: The input was not valid: one plain-English message per field.

/api/v1/tools/directors-loan.summary: Director's loan tax and benefit in kind calculator
/api/v1/tools/directors-loan.description: Works out section 455 tax and repayment relief on a director's loan, with an optional beneficial-loan estimate using HMRC's normal averaging method, the director's marginal Income Tax rate and the company's Class 1A National Insurance.

get.summary: Director's loan tax and benefit in kind calculator (query string)
get.description: Works out section 455 tax and repayment relief on a director's loan, with an optional beneficial-loan estimate using HMRC's normal averaging method, the director's marginal Income Tax rate and the company's Class 1A National Insurance.

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Last day of the company's Corporation Tax accounting period, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: outstanding
parameters.description: Loan balance the director or other participator owed the company at the period end, in pounds.

parameters.name: repaid_within_9_months
parameters.description: Part of that balance repaid, released or written off after the period end and within 9 months of it (before the s.455 tax is due), in pounds. Default 0.

parameters.name: loan_made_on
parameters.description: Date the loan was made, YYYY-MM-DD, within the accounting period. It sets the rate: 33.75% for loans made 6 April 2022 to 5 April 2026, 35.75% from 6 April 2026. Required when the 12 months to period_end include a rate change (for example a period ending between 6 April 2026 and 4 April 2027). Otherwise it defaults to the period end.

parameters.name: benefit_tax_year
parameters.description: Optional UK tax year for the beneficial-loan calculation: 2025-26 or 2026-27. Omit to calculate s.455 only.

parameters.name: benefit_opening_balance
parameters.description: Maximum loan balance on 5 April before the selected tax year, or when the loan began, in pounds. Defaults to outstanding.

parameters.name: benefit_closing_balance
parameters.description: Maximum loan balance on 5 April at the end of the selected tax year, or when the loan ended, in pounds. Defaults to outstanding.

parameters.name: benefit_maximum_balance
parameters.description: Highest total beneficial-loan balance at any time in the tax year, in pounds, used for the £10,000 exemption. Defaults to the larger opening or closing balance.

parameters.name: benefit_whole_months
parameters.description: Whole months the loan was outstanding in the selected tax year, from 1 to 12. Defaults to 12.

parameters.name: benefit_interest_paid
parameters.description: Interest the director was required to pay and actually paid for the selected tax year, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: marginal_income_tax_rate
parameters.description: Director’s marginal Income Tax rate as a percentage, used only to estimate personal tax on the benefit. Defaults to 20.

422.description: The input was not valid: one plain-English message per field.

/api/v1/tools/capital-allowances.description: Works out a UK limited company's capital allowances for one accounting period: the annual investment allowance, full expensing, the 50% and zero-emission car first-year allowances, and writing-down allowances at 14% (18% before 1 April 2026, a hybrid rate for a period spanning that date) and 6%.

get.summary: Capital allowances calculator for companies (query string)
get.description: Works out a UK limited company's capital allowances for one accounting period: the annual investment allowance, full expensing, the 50% and zero-emission car first-year allowances, and writing-down allowances at 14% (18% before 1 April 2026, a hybrid rate for a period spanning that date) and 6%.

parameters.name: period_start
parameters.description: First day of the Corporation Tax accounting period, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after 2023-04-01.

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Last day of the accounting period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The period can be up to 12 months long.

parameters.name: spend_date
parameters.description: Optional. When the purchases were made (YYYY-MM-DD, inside the period). Defaults to the period end. It only changes the answer for zero-emission cars: their 100% first-year allowance is for spending up to 2027-03-31.

parameters.name: new_main_plant
parameters.description: Cost of new and unused plant, machinery, equipment and vans (not cars). Gets the annual investment allowance, then full expensing (100%) on any amount above it.

parameters.name: used_main_plant
parameters.description: Cost of second-hand main-rate plant, machinery, equipment and vans (not cars). Gets the annual investment allowance; any excess goes into the main pool.

parameters.name: new_special_rate
parameters.description: Cost of new and unused integral features (electrical, lighting, heating, water, lifts, air conditioning), long-life assets, thermal insulation and solar panels. Gets the annual investment allowance, then the 50% first-year allowance on any excess.

parameters.name: used_special_rate
parameters.description: Cost of second-hand integral features, long-life assets, thermal insulation and solar panels. Gets the annual investment allowance; any excess goes into the special rate pool.

parameters.name: zero_emission_cars
parameters.description: Cost of new and unused cars with 0 g/km CO2 (fully electric). 100% first-year allowance for spending up to 31 March 2027; after that they go into the main pool. Enter a second-hand electric car under other_cars_low_co2.

parameters.name: other_cars_low_co2
parameters.description: Cost of cars (other than new zero-emission cars) with CO2 emissions of 50 g/km or less. They go into the main pool. Cars never get the annual investment allowance or full expensing.

parameters.name: other_cars_high_co2
parameters.description: Cost of cars with CO2 emissions over 50 g/km. They go into the special rate pool (6%).

parameters.name: main_pool_brought_forward
parameters.description: Main pool balance carried forward from the previous accounting period (0 if none).

parameters.name: special_pool_brought_forward
parameters.description: Special rate pool balance carried forward from the previous accounting period (0 if none).

parameters.name: main_pool_disposals
parameters.description: Sale proceeds of main pool assets sold this period that did NOT have full expensing (for example, assets that had the annual investment allowance or were pooled). Enter the lower of the sale price and what the asset cost.

parameters.name: full_expensed_disposals
parameters.description: Sale proceeds of assets that had full expensing on their whole cost, sold this period. The whole amount is a balancing charge. Enter the lower of the sale price and what the asset cost.

parameters.name: aia_shared
parameters.description: Optional. Companies in a group or under common control share one £1,000,000 annual investment allowance. Enter the amount given to the other companies for this period; this company gets the rest.

422.description: The input was not valid: one plain-English message per field.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.

/api/v1/tools/chargeable-gains.summary: Chargeable gains calculator for companies (with indexation)
/api/v1/tools/chargeable-gains.description: Works out a UK limited company's chargeable gain or allowable loss when it sells UK land or buildings, or shares it bought in one purchase, including indexation allowance frozen at December 2017.

get.summary: Chargeable gains calculator for companies (with indexation) (query string)
get.description: Works out a UK limited company's chargeable gain or allowable loss when it sells UK land or buildings, or shares it bought in one purchase, including indexation allowance frozen at December 2017.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: "land_buildings": UK land or buildings (the company's whole interest; a freehold or a lease with more than 50 years left). "shares": shares in one company that were all bought in a single purchase and all sold together. Other assets and shares bought at different times are not covered.

parameters.name: acquisition_date
parameters.description: When the company bought the asset (exchange of contracts), as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after 1987-01-01.

parameters.name: acquisition_cost
parameters.description: What the company paid for the asset, in pounds.

parameters.name: acquisition_costs
parameters.description: Optional. Costs of buying it: legal fees, Stamp Duty Land Tax, survey and agent fees.

parameters.name: enhancement_date
parameters.description: Optional, land and buildings only. When the company paid for one improvement (for example an extension), as YYYY-MM-DD. Give it with enhancement_cost.

parameters.name: enhancement_cost
parameters.description: Optional, land and buildings only. Cost of one capital improvement that is still reflected in the property when it is sold (not repairs or maintenance).

parameters.name: sba_claimed
parameters.description: Optional, land and buildings only. Total structures and buildings allowance the company claimed on the building. It is added to the sale price.

parameters.name: disposal_date
parameters.description: When the company sold the asset (exchange of contracts), as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: proceeds
parameters.description: What the company sold the asset for, in pounds.

parameters.name: disposal_costs
parameters.description: Optional. Costs of selling it: agent and legal fees.

/api/v1/tools/company-size.summary: Micro-entity and small company size checker
/api/v1/tools/company-size.description: Checks whether a UK private company is a micro-entity, small, or neither for a financial year under the Companies Act 2006, using the limits raised for years starting on or after 6 April 2025, the 2-of-3 test, turnover pro-rating for short or long years, and the two-consecutive-years rule.

get.description: Checks whether a UK private company is a micro-entity, small, or neither for a financial year under the Companies Act 2006, using the limits raised for years starting on or after 6 April 2025, the 2-of-3 test, turnover pro-rating for short or long years, and the two-consecutive-years rule.

parameters.name: period_start
parameters.description: First day of the financial year (accounts period), YYYY-MM-DD. The limits depend on this date.

parameters.name: period_end
parameters.description: Last day of the financial year, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 18 months after the start.

parameters.name: turnover
parameters.description: Turnover for the financial year, in pounds.

parameters.name: balance_sheet_total
parameters.description: Balance sheet total: gross assets (fixed plus current assets, before liabilities) at the year end, in pounds.

parameters.name: employees
parameters.description: Average number of employees in the year (monthly headcounts added up, divided by the number of months).

parameters.name: first_year
parameters.description: True if this is the company's first financial year (then this year alone decides its size).

parameters.name: prev_turnover
parameters.description: Optional: last financial year's turnover, in pounds (assumed a 12-month year).

parameters.name: prev_balance_sheet_total
parameters.description: Optional: last year's balance sheet total (gross assets), in pounds.

parameters.name: prev_employees
parameters.description: Optional: last year's average number of employees.

parameters.name: prev_size
parameters.description: Optional: what the company qualified as last year — micro, small (not micro) or medium_or_large (not small). Used by the two-year rule when this year's result differs from last year's figures.

/api/v1/tools/company-car.description: Works out the benefit in kind on a UK company car for 2025/26 or 2026/27: the appropriate percentage, the car and fuel benefit, the director's Income Tax and the company's 15% Class 1A National Insurance.

get.description: Works out the benefit in kind on a UK company car for 2025/26 or 2026/27: the appropriate percentage, the car and fuel benefit, the director's Income Tax and the company's 15% Class 1A National Insurance.

parameters.name: tax_year
parameters.description: UK tax year: "2025-26" (6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026) or "2026-27" (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027).

parameters.name: list_price
parameters.description: The car's list price when new, including VAT, delivery and any optional extras (the P11D price), in pounds. Not the price the company paid.

parameters.name: capital_contribution
parameters.description: Optional. What the director paid towards the cost of the car or its extras, in pounds. Up to £5,000 is deducted from the list price. Default 0.

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: "electric" (fully electric or any car with 0 g/km CO2), "petrol" (petrol, or ANY hybrid, petrol or diesel, including plug-in hybrids: hybrids never pay the diesel supplement), "diesel_rde2" (a diesel-only car certified to Euro 6d, also called RDE2: no supplement), or "diesel" (any other diesel-only car: a 4% supplement, up to 37%).

parameters.name: co2_gkm
parameters.description: The car's approved CO2 emissions in g/km, from the V5C or certificate of conformity (WLTP for cars first registered from 6 April 2020, NEDC before; both give the same percentage in 2025/26 and 2026/27). Required unless fuel_type is "electric".

parameters.name: electric_range_miles
parameters.description: For a plug-in hybrid only: the zero-emission (electric) range in miles from the certificate of conformity, rounded up. Required for a car with CO2 of 1 to 50 g/km, or when phev_easement is true; ignored otherwise.

parameters.name: phev_easement
parameters.description: Optional. True for a plug-in hybrid first registered on or after 1 January 2025 under Euro 6e-bis or a later emissions standard (not Euro 6d-ISC-FCM or Euro 6e) whose CO2 is 51 g/km or more. Its CO2 is then treated as 1 g/km, so it is taxed by electric range. Default false.

parameters.name: months_available
parameters.description: Optional. Months in the tax year the car is available for the director's private use, 1 to 12. Default 12. The benefit is reduced in proportion.

parameters.name: private_fuel
parameters.description: Optional. True if the company pays for fuel for private journeys and the director does not repay all of it. Adds the car fuel benefit (not for electric cars). Default false.

parameters.name: income_tax_rate
parameters.description: The director's top rate of Income Tax including the benefit: "basic" (20%), "higher" (40%) or "additional" (45%). Rates for England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

parameters.name: acquisition
parameters.description: Optional. "buy" if the company buys the car (capital allowances), "lease" if it leases it (the rental is deductible). Default "buy".

parameters.name: price_paid
parameters.description: Optional, for "buy". What the company paid for the car, in pounds, for its capital allowances. Default: the list price.

parameters.name: new_car
parameters.description: Optional, for "buy". True if the car is new and unused. Only a new and unused zero-emission car gets the 100% first-year allowance. Default false.

parameters.name: annual_lease_cost
parameters.description: For "lease": the lease rentals the company pays in its year, in pounds, excluding VAT it can reclaim. Required for "lease".

parameters.name: lease_started
parameters.description: Optional, for "lease": the date the hire period began, YYYY-MM-DD. It sets the CO2 threshold for the 15% restriction: 50 g/km from 1 April 2021, 110 g/km from 1 April 2018, 130 g/km from 1 April 2013, 160 g/km from 1 April 2009. Default: on or after 1 April 2021.

parameters.name: company_profits
parameters.description: Optional. The company's taxable profits for its year before the car's allowances or lease rentals and the Class 1A, in pounds. With it, the Corporation Tax saved is worked out exactly (19%, marginal relief or 25%); without it, as a range at 19% and 25%.

parameters.name: associated_companies
parameters.description: Optional, with company_profits. The number of other companies under common control; it divides the £50,000 and £250,000 limits. Default 0.
